texts:
(i) SOS/I_glob pair C: 1 W/m² planetary
boundary (Bjørn & Hauschild 2015)

(ii) GDP per capita, current US$
(NY.GDP.PCAP.CD), b = 2024

(iii) AR base window 2021-2025 (5 yr, as
Horup)

(iv) NZ population: WPP 2024
probabilistic median, New Zealand

(iv) NZ population: raw Stats NZ
2024-base median (no 2025 observation,
no nowcast)

(v) s_sec with FCE share as ratio of
sums

(vi) Frozen technology: 2025 factors
held (A1-A3 and A4-A5 not decarbonised)

(x) A4-A5 on each item's own Horup S4
path

(xi) Event timing: interval L / n
(instead of L / (n + 1))

(xii) Accounting: whole life at
construction (base on the same rule)

(xiii) Wider scope: base and projection
include the maintenance (B2, B4) of
every cohort since 1992

(xiv) AtP with alpha = 1, as computed in
Hjalsted et al.'s SI tables
Change in cumulative level of exceedance vs the Reference
note: One setting changed per row; labels show the cumulative LoE of that row and its change from the Reference. Rows that do not enter a principle (e.g. the GDP measure for AR) show no change. Percentages are relative to carbon 2026–2050 (time-resolved accounting); fixed absolute terms such as soil carbon loss therefore show larger percentage effects than under whole-life accounting. The largest effects on the AR and AtP LoE, grouped: Extended Data ED4 (carbon: ED1).
